scenes.title: If they need a decoder, it is not an offer.
scenes.body: A one-page offer is not a brochure. It is a decision tool. Outcome, scope, deadline, price, proof.
scenes.voice: If they need a decoder ring to understand your offer, it is not an offer. It is a riddle. A one-page offer is a decision tool, not a brochure.

scenes.title: Everything else is optional. These five are not.
scenes.body: 1. Outcome  2. Scope  3. Deadline  4. Price  5. Proof (even tiny)
scenes.voice: Five parts. Everything else is optional. These five are not. Outcome. Scope. Deadline. Price. And some form of proof, even if it is tiny.

scenes.title: What changes for them?
scenes.body: Not what you will do. What they will have, see, or stop worrying about when you are done.
scenes.voice: Outcome. What changes for them? Not the activities you will perform. What they will have, see, or stop worrying about when you are finished.

scenes.title: What is included. What is not.
scenes.body: Boundaries protect both sides. 'I will do X. I will not do Y or Z.' Clear is kind.
scenes.voice: Scope. What is included and what is not. Boundaries protect both sides. I will do X. I will not do Y or Z. Clear is kind.

scenes.title: When and how much. No mystery.
scenes.body: Specific delivery date or turnaround. One number or a simple range with what moves it.
scenes.voice: Deadline and price. When they get it and how much it costs. Specific delivery date or turnaround window. One clear number or a simple range that explains what moves the price.

scenes.title: Even a tiny scrap beats nothing.
scenes.body: Before/after, a named similar result, a short process note, or 'I have done this exact thing for three other teams'.
scenes.voice: Proof. Even a tiny scrap beats nothing. A before and after, a named similar result, a short process note, or simply I have done this exact thing for three other teams.

scenes.title: One page. Readable on a phone.
scenes.body: Big outcome at top. Then the four remaining pieces. CTA at the bottom. No walls of text.
scenes.voice: Format. One page. Readable on a phone. Big outcome at the top. Then the remaining pieces. Call to action at the bottom. No walls of text. No jargon.

scenes.title: Write one for a real problem today.
scenes.body: Pick a service you can actually deliver. Fill the five slots. Send it to one real person.
scenes.voice: Your next move. Write one for a real problem today. Pick a service you can actually deliver. Fill the five slots. Send it to one real person. The fancy deck can stay in the drawer.

scenes.title: If they need a decoder, rewrite.
scenes.body: Offers are decision tools, not brochures.
scenes.voice: If they need a decoder to understand your offer, rewrite it. Offers are decision tools, not brochures.

scenes.title: Outcome. Scope. Deadline. Price. Proof.
scenes.body: Everything else is optional. These five are not.
scenes.voice: Five parts. Outcome. Scope. Deadline. Price. Proof. Everything else is optional.

scenes.title: What changes for them?
scenes.voice: Outcome first. What changes for them? Not your activities. Their result.

scenes.title: Boundaries. When. How much. Tiny proof.
scenes.body: Clear is kind. Mystery is expensive.
scenes.voice: Then the rest. Boundaries, when, how much, and even tiny proof. Clear is kind. Mystery is expensive.

scenes.title: One page. Phone readable. Send it.
scenes.body: Write one for a real problem today.
scenes.voice: That is it. One page. Phone readable. Write one for a real problem today and send it. Template in the description.
